summarize_ATOM37: summarize the ATOM37 tuple of 37 canonical protein atom names used for fixed-size residue arrays
summarize_ATOM14: summarize the ATOM14 mapping of per-residue atom tuples padded to 14 columns for compact storage
summarize_DENSE_ATOM: summarize the DENSE_ATOM mapping covering protein, RNA, and DNA residue atom tuples for unified atom libraries
summarize_RESIDUE_ATOMS: summarize the RESIDUE_ATOMS mapping of all 20 standard amino acids to their non-hydrogen atom names
summarize_PROTONATION_HYDROGENS: summarize the PROTONATION_HYDROGENS mapping of residues to their pH-dependent hydrogen atoms
